name: Satellite conjunction
description: Another satellite may cross the spacecraft's path.

name: Debris shower
description: Several fragments may pass close enough to damage instruments.

name: Unknown asteroid
description: An asteroid may cross the spacecraft's path.

name: Engine malfunction
description: An engine loses efficiency or stops firing.

name: Propellant leak
description: A liquid stage loses propellant over time.

name: Sensor failure
description: A working telemetry instrument stops reporting.
